B.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number, mixed number, or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form without changing its value.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a fractional part such as 0/d.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a fractional part is simplified before subtraction to create an equivalent easier form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag merely identifying a problem type without rewriting any quantity.
Do not tag finding a common denominator for unlike fractions.
Do not tag the actual subtraction or final simplification of the result.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are rewritten as equivalent fractions to match denominators.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction subtraction within pure fractions or mixed-number fraction parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed.
Do not tag normalization such as rewriting a whole number as 0/d unless fractions are then converted to a new denominator.
Do not tag numerator subtraction itself.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution subtracts whole and fraction parts separately after normalization or denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the borrowing or regrouping step used to fix a negative fractional difference.
Do not tag finding the common denominator or rewriting operands into equivalent forms.
Do not tag reducing the final answer to lowest terms.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Borrow or regroup across whole and fractional parts when needed, then express the final result in simplest valid form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is borrowed and converted into denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when a negative fractional difference is resolved by regrouping between whole and fraction parts.
Tag when the result is simplified from a reducible fraction or from a zero-fraction mixed number to simplest form.
Tag when the final whole and fractional parts are combined into the accepted final form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction that requires no regrouping and no simplification beyond the already simplest result.
Do not tag operand normalization done before subtraction.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including normalization, common denominators, borrowing, and simplification

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a zero fractional part or converting a mixed number with an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0/n before subtraction
Tag when a step converts a mixed number with an improper fraction part into an equivalent standard mixed number
Tag when a step simplifies a fractional part inside a mixed number before subtraction to make the form easier to use
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag merely identifying a problem type without rewriting any quantity
Do not tag finding a common denominator for two fractions
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part after subtraction has begun

skills.name: Create common denominator
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with matching denominators
Tag even if the denominators are already equal but the solver explicitly performs the common-denominator setup
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction of fractions that already share a denominator when no conversion is performed
Do not tag simplifying a result after subtraction
Do not tag rewriting whole numbers or mixed numbers into standard form

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract whole-number parts and fractional parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted
Tag when fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after normalization or denominator alignment
Tag when the solver combines the computed whole and fractional parts into the stated result form
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create a common denominator
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps used because the fractional subtraction would be negative
Do not tag simplification of an already obtained fraction unless subtraction is also performed in that same step

skills.name: Borrow and simplify
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units when the fractional subtraction is negative, and reduce any resulting fraction or zero form to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into n/n fractional units
Tag when regrouping changes a negative fractional difference into a positive fractional subtraction
Tag when a step simplifies a fraction such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0 after subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping or simplification occurs
Do not tag initial rewriting of whole numbers as whole plus 0/n
Do not tag finding an LCD or converting equivalent fractions before subtraction

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction forms
skills.definition: Rewrite fractional quantities into a usable equivalent form before subtraction, such as finding a common denominator or normalizing a mixed number with an improper fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when the solution rewrites a mixed number containing an improper fraction part into a standard equivalent mixed number.
Tag when the step explicitly converts fraction parts so the subtraction can be carried out consistently.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0/n; that is part of mixed/whole subtraction setup rather than denominator equalization.
Do not tag pure subtraction or simplification steps.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they are already expressed with compatible denominators, including same-denominator fraction subtraction inside mixed-number work.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators over a shared denominator.
Tag when the fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted after they already have matching denominators.
Tag whether the result is positive, zero, or initially negative before borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag denominator-conversion steps.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that fix a negative fractional difference.
Do not tag final simplification unless an actual subtraction of fractions occurs in that step.

skills.name: Subtract mixed/whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract and combine whole-number and fractional parts in problems involving mixed numbers or whole numbers, including rewriting a whole number as a mixed form with 0/n when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately in a mixed-number or whole-number context.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n to align with a mixed number or fraction.
Tag when the solution combines the resulting whole and fractional parts into a mixed number or integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction-minus-fraction items with no whole-number structure.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to equivalent-form preparation.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping itself; that is a separate operation.

skills.name: Borrow and simplify
skills.definition: Regroup one whole into fractional units when the fractional part is too small to subtract, and reduce any resulting fraction or zero form to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into n/n added to the fractional part.
Tag when regrouping resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
Tag when the solution simplifies a non-reduced fraction or converts 0/n to 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps that do not require regrouping or simplification.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts unless borrowing or simplification is also performed in the tagged step.
